scope: Reconciled exceptions, relationships, exclusions, and external candidates from the evidence-bounded Phase 2 inventory. This report does not mutate canonical methods, runtime support, or product parity.

records.rationale: Ax is a distinct experiment-lifecycle layer built around BoTorch; it is not a fork or duplicate implementation.
BCEAweb is a separate UI package using BCEA, not a renamed BCEA package or evidence of hosted-service terms.
dampack is a separate decision-analysis package that can integrate with DARTH templates; it is not the DARTH template itself.
Public documentation establishes spreadsheet risk analysis and decision tables, not EVPI, EVPPI, EVSI, or another direct VOI estimator.
Public v8.3 documentation supports spreadsheet decision analysis, Bayesian revision and sensitivity features, but not direct VOI or risk-adjusted information-pricing estimands.
TPWeb is the login-gated hosted sharing surface for prepared TreeAge Pro models, with historically documented quotas that must not be asserted current.
Trieste is a distinct TensorFlow/GPflow-oriented Bayesian-optimization implementation, conceptually comparable to BoTorch but neither a fork nor a direct VOI engine.
The official GAMS EMP airsp3 example computes EEV-style evaluation, wait-and-see, EVPI and VSS, but the licensed product lacks a complete public inventory record and generalized API evidence.
This untagged research application demonstrates nonmyopic informative sensing but lacks a package release, reproducible environment and complete product extraction.

limitations: Unobserved products, private capabilities, unavailable supplements, and terminology variants can remain outside the recorded discovery channels.
An excluded or deferred record can be reopened only with fresh observable evidence; it is not a claim that the capability does not exist.
External candidates require the same version, rights, extraction and reproducibility review as retained inventory products before inclusion.
